title: We didn't study this problem.
We lived it.
about.body: We're engineers and project managers who spent years in the field, facing the same delays, lost communications and endless paperwork you face every day.
about.quote: So we decided to build the platform we always wished existed.

cost.title: What does a week's delay on one approval cost you?
cost.lead: What you've spent on the project only comes back to you at handover, and every week of delay pushes that back a week.
cost.assumptions: Assumptions: cost of money at 8% a year, whether financing or a forgone return, on what has been spent so far, if the approval delays handover by the same period. Excludes delayed revenue, supervision fees, contractor claims and penalties.

parties.title: Bridging the gap between the stakeholders.
parties.lead: Most software serves one party. Rabaed puts owner, consultant and contractor on one record, and each party keeps an internal review the others never see.
parties.footer: A win for all three parties.

platform.title: Four units. One record gathers them.
platform.lead: Each unit serves the owner's, the consultant's and the contractor's work where it happens, and they share one output: the documented Record.

modules.name: Official correspondence
modules.text: Letters with reference numbers, reply status and how long each party has waited. If the project manager leaves, the letters stay with the project.

modules.name: Approvals and requests
modules.text: Draft, internal review, then approval. Escalations and reminders fire automatically, and every step carries a name and a time. Every approval exports to PDF with a reference number and a check code.

modules.name: Daily site report
modules.text: Labor, equipment, activities, materials and photos, with weekly and monthly reports generated automatically.

modules.name: Documents and revisions
modules.text: Always the latest revision, with every earlier one and who uploaded it, ready the moment a claim or dispute arises.

platform.output: The output: the documented Record. Every request and approval dated with the name of whoever made it.

record.title: Don't ask "who approved?" Open the transaction.
record.body: The Record in Rabaed isn't a feature you switch on. It's the result of every step. Any transaction that passes through the platform carries its full record: an official letter, a material approval, a work inspection request or a schedule update. After the project ends, the record itself is still there.

templates.title: Forms, ready out of the box.
templates.lead: Every Saudi construction form your team already uses: pre-built, routed and tracked, and exported to a clean PDF in one click. No setup, no template engineering.

why.title: Three things no competitor can claim at once.

items.name: User-friendly Arabic interface
items.text: A fully Arabic interface with simple screens. Any site engineer can use it from day one, with no long training. Non-Arabic teams get an English interface.

items.name: Onsite support
items.text: Our team comes to your site in Saudi Arabia: we set it up, train your people and fix problems fast. Same language, same time zone.

items.name: Built and priced for SMEs
items.text: Made for firms running 2 to 10 projects, all from one account. One clear yearly subscription, with no big contracts and no hidden fees.

impact.activation: Fully live on site within days, with no stoppage.
